_comment: Space Marines 11th edition codex: units moved to Warhammer Legends (Classic Dreadnought, Centurions, Razorback, Predators, Vindicator, Whirlwind, Stormhawk/Stormtalon/Stormraven, Hammerfall Bunker) and units that became Legendary Proxies only (Tactical Squad, Devastator Squad, Suppressor Squad, Pedro Kantor, Uriel Ventris).

datasheets.name: Victrix Honour Guard
datasheets._note: 0-1 Chapter Ancient (banner of Macragge, +15) and 0-1 Chapter Champion (blades of honour, +10) are Honour Guard models with other gear

wargearOptions.text: 1 Victrix Honour Guard model can be the Chapter Ancient: master-crafted power weapon and banner of Macragge.
1 Victrix Honour Guard model can be the Chapter Champion: blades of honour.
